fields.Name: T102 - Create New Query Drawer
fields.Description: Exercises the bespoke query create drawer (OpenCreateDrawer + SaveDrawer) with its SQL code editor and tree-dropdown category — a purpose-built form distinct from the generic entity create-record form.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to Data Explorer, and open the Queries section. In the query panel header click the '+' (New Query) icon button to open the New Query drawer. Fill in a Name (e.g. 'CU Regression Test Query'), optionally pick a Category and Status, and type a simple SELECT statement into the SQL code editor. Click Save. Success is the drawer's create form rendering with all fields (Name, Category, Status, Reusable checkbox, Description, SQL editor) and the Save action being accepted (drawer closes and the new query appears/selects) — OR, if you lack create permission, the '+' button simply not being present is also a valid outcome to report. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The New Query drawer opens with Name, Category dropdown, Status dropdown, Reusable checkbox, Description, and a SQL code editor
After entering a Name and SQL and clicking Save, the drawer closes without error (the created query is selected/visible), OR the create '+' button is legitimately absent due to permissions
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
